Live Demonstration
Stand inside the code. See which container owns each thing, how it was created, where the same live object goes next, and how human intention returns as visible meaning.
The Builder Field Guide teaches the architecture. This page lets you witness it inhabiting real VexLife code without asking you to invent the missing edges.
How to use this page
Do not memorize the examples. Follow the scopes and relationships.

This page does not redefine VexArchitecture. The Builder Field Guide owns the architectural explanation. Here, every step starts by naming the container we are inside, the member we are touching, what kind of thing it is, why traversal arrived there, and the exact next edge. No introduced object is allowed to disappear behind “later.” Code blocks are scoped teaching excerpts: surrounding lines and incidental syntax may be omitted or normalized for readability. The linked source path and blob own the byte-exact code; this page claims the shown ownership, scope, and traversal relationships.
Origin witness

ThemeMode receives the full construction-to-human walk because it makes the ownership chain concrete from dependency construction through presentation. The linked #209 snapshot is preserved as the witness for this walk; the lesson is the ownership relationship, not the age of the snapshot.
Playback relationship witness

VexStream Playback demonstrates the relationship: Direct VexFamily authors semantic meaning, the bound Method enters VexExecution, Player requests cross VexStreamPlayerPartner, later Player Signals become VexStreamPlayerStore truth, and the same Family observes that Store. PlaybackService and Widget reuse those owners without becoming semantic State.
Relay relationship witness
VexMaps Distribution demonstrates independent semantic owners and Relay/convergence without pretending Relay owns either source truth.

Copy/paste chunk B · Playback relationship walk
VexStream Playback · relationship witness
Follow Playback through Direct Family, Player Partner, Store, Service, and Widget without inventing another State owner

This walk follows Android source snapshot d857a923…. Playback meaning is authored by VexStreamPlaybackFamily; an accepted Act binds an exact Method and uses VexExecution only for earned custody. The request crosses VexStreamPlayerPartner, while later Media3 observations become Player Signals retained by VexStreamPlayerStore and observed back into the same Family. VexStreamPlaybackService keeps the MediaSession/ExoPlayer realization and Widget publication alive; it does not create a VexService root or universal Service current.
Copy/paste chunk C · Relay relationship walk
VexMaps Distribution · relationship witness
Watch process-local construction, one local semantic owner, then relationship truth without collapsing ownership

Maps makes both lifetime and relationship pressure visible. VexMapsMapSurface asks a process-local allocator for the lived Distribution session, wraps it in a UI boundary, then Mode and Delivery Route remain independent owners while a Relay observes their projections and may request Mode’s public Control.
After walking four systems
The implementations differ. The questions become recognizable.

ThemeMode, VexStream, Maps, and Partner should not be collapsed into one class template. What transfers is the ability to locate human intention, semantic ownership, external participation, outside truth, active custody, relationship truth, durability, and the presentation that returns to the human.

The architecture becomes easier to recognize when nothing important has to teleport between code snippets.

When you enter unfamiliar code, keep asking the next concrete navigation question: what container am I in, what member am I touching, who supplied it, what kind of thing is it here, and where does this exact value or object go next? Follow the value all the way across human intention, Family meaning, execution, external participation, durable truth, and presentation. The Builder Field Guide explains the wisdom behind those relationships; this page exists so you can see them live.
External-participant relationship witness

VexPartner is shown because CGM, connected-pen, insulin-pump, and VexStream Player sources preserve the same Source/Signal/Connection grammar across provider representation, direction, persistence, restart, and product domains. The walk separates the reusable Partner boundary from consumer-owned Store/Family admission.

Copy/paste chunk D · external-participant walk
VexPartner · external-participant circuit
Walk outside truth into Family meaning — and Family intention back out — without inventing a mirrored semantic owner

This walk follows Partner source snapshot 7800c179…. CGM pressures two provider representations, connected pen removes CGM-specific sequence/periodic assumptions, and insulin pump proves the outbound Family → Partner direction. Read Store → Family as the CGM/insulin concrete realization after Receiver, not as a mandatory child of VexPartner. Real Local HTTP/BLE lifecycle is outside what this witness proves.
